exercises.title: Steering and spatial awareness

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Student Driver (4-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP dirt arena (MAPS W2): the course is laid out from the venue's spawn, heading south-west across the open dirt (about 40 m of room needed ahead).

exercises.instructions: Drive through the gate, keep the cone on your left, and stop with the whole car inside the parking box. One stop, no reversing.
exercises.resetInstructions: Go to drill puts you at the start with the gate, cone and box laid out ahead. Mark start moves the course to where you are; Use venue start puts it back.
exercises.props: None: the gate, cone and parking box are drawn for you.

assessment.successDefinition: Through the 3 m gate and past the cone on the correct side without touching either, then stop once with the whole car inside the 6 x 3.2 m box, without reversing. Silver: inside the silver box (0.3 m smaller all round) in 14 s or less. Gold: inside the gold box (0.5 m smaller) in 10 s or less.

exercises.title: Clutch engagement and launches

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Student Driver (4-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track (MAPS W1): the course is laid out from the venue's spawn on the tarmac start line, with the 40 km/h gate 60 m down the straight. The run ends at the gate, so nobody has to stop on the straight's banked end.

exercises.instructions: Launch, shift 1→2 and be at 40 km/h or more through the 40 km/h gate. The run ends at the gate; then slow down and stop wherever you like. No stall, no long wheelspin.
exercises.resetInstructions: Go to drill puts you on the start line with the gate laid out ahead. Move course here re-lays it from where you are.
exercises.props: None: the gate is drawn for you. Manual gearbox; keep the same clutch assist settings between attempts.

assessment.successDefinition: Through the 40 km/h gate (60 m) at 40 km/h or more, having shifted 1→2: no stall, no shift hanging in neutral over 1 s, no wheelspin over 1 s, 0–40 km/h within 8 s of moving off. The run ends at the gate. Silver: 0–40 in 4.5 s, shift under 0.6 s, wheelspin under 0.5 s. Gold: 0–40 in 3.5 s, shift under 0.4 s, wheelspin under 0.25 s.
assessment.metricToRecord: Clean launches / 10 (and your best 0–40 km/h time)

exercises.title: Gear selection and downshifting

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Student Driver (4-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track run-up (MAPS W1): accelerate along the run-up and downshift to stop by an end gate on the flat, up to 45 m past the start line.

exercises.instructions: Accelerate to 60 km/h and downshift progressively to 2nd as you slow before the end gate.
exercises.resetInstructions: Go to drill puts you 120 m behind the start line. Mark the end gate on the flat, no more than 45 m past the line.
exercises.props: Use tachometer HUD; no racing downshifts.

assessment.successDefinition: Correct shifts without over-rev, wheel lock, stall or missed shift; stop before gate.

exercises.title: Throttle modulation

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Student Driver (4-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track (MAPS W1), start line ~(103, 165). Main straight: mark three 25 m timing zones.

exercises.instructions: Bring the car to 30 km/h, then hold that speed through three gates 25 m apart.
exercises.resetInstructions: Mark the start 30 m before the first gate, facing down the straight. Drive to each gate spot in turn (25 m apart) and press + Gate.
exercises.props: Speedometer only; the build-up to the first gate is not graded.

assessment.successDefinition: Speed at each of the three gates between 27 and 33 km/h; no braking between the first and last gate.
assessment.metricToRecord: Runs with all three gates in band

exercises.title: Braking accuracy

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Student Driver (4-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP dirt arena (MAPS W2), open dirt ~(337, 96), fenced. Straight approach to a stop box marked on the open dirt.

exercises.instructions: Brake once from 40 km/h and stop at a cone-marked line.
exercises.resetInstructions: Mark the start about 80 m before the line. Mark the line by parking with your front bumper on it, facing the way you'll arrive, and pressing Mark stop line.
exercises.props: Use visible cone pair to indicate line; adjust start distance for runway available.

assessment.successDefinition: Front bumper ends 0-2 m before the line, braking from 40 km/h, with no wheel lock. Cone contact: not graded yet.

exercises.title: Vision and looking ahead

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Student Driver (4-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track (MAPS W1), start line ~(103, 165). Figure Eight Basics layout: call the next bend aloud before each apex.

exercises.instructions: Drive bends while speaking the *next* turn direction and apex marker aloud before current apex.
exercises.resetInstructions: Stationary 50 m before first bend; fix start direction.
exercises.props: Voice-record or self-score; course layout fixed, no visual eye-tracking assumed.

assessment.successDefinition: Name the following bend and its target before the first apex; complete both cleanly.

exercises.title: Basic racing lines

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track (MAPS W1), start line ~(103, 165). Pick one medium-speed corner on the circuit.

exercises.instructions: Compare early, middle and late-apex lines; finish with 10 scored laps using the most repeatable line.
exercises.resetInstructions: Stationary 60 m before braking marker, same approach line.
exercises.props: Run 3 exploratory passes per line before 10 scored attempts.

assessment.successDefinition: Clean corner, all wheels on pavement and through a 3 m exit gate.
assessment.metricToRecord: Clean exits and exit speed at gate

exercises.title: Apex and exit selection

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track (MAPS W1), start line ~(103, 165). Same corner as A07.

exercises.instructions: Move the apex gate slightly later and target a stable, straight corner exit.
exercises.resetInstructions: Reuse A07 checkpoint and exit gate.
exercises.props: Place paired cones at apex and exit; preserve cone layout.

assessment.successDefinition: Pass a 3 m apex gate without touching either cone, then a 3 m exit gate, with no corrections after exit.

exercises.title: Threshold braking

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Student Driver (4-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track run-up (MAPS W1): start 120 m behind the start line; the straight is flat from 60 m before the start line to 50 m past it, then cambers and banks, so stops belong between the line and about 45 m past it.

exercises.instructions: From 70 km/h, brake progressively to the stop zone; adjust brake pressure near grip limit.
exercises.resetInstructions: Go to drill puts you 120 m behind the start line. Accelerate to 70 km/h and mark the stop zone on the flat gravel 25-45 m past the line (the straight banks further on).
exercises.props: Keep any ABS settings unchanged; watch front wheels / brake HUD.

assessment.successDefinition: Reach at least 65 km/h, then stop with the car's centre inside the 5 m x 6 m zone, with no wheel locked for more than 0.5 s. (Cone contact: not graded yet.)

exercises.title: Wheel lockup recognition and correction

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Student Driver (4-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track run-up (MAPS W1): same braking zone as B01; the straight is flat from 60 m before the start line to 50 m past it, then cambers and banks, so stops belong between the line and about 45 m past it.

exercises.instructions: Briefly provoke lockup using heavy braking, release enough to restore rolling grip and stop.
exercises.resetInstructions: Go to drill puts you 120 m behind the start line. Reach 60 km/h and brake so you stop before about 45 m past the line, while the gravel is still flat.
exercises.props: Verify ABS is absent/disabled; if ABS cannot be removed use another non-ABS configuration.

assessment.successDefinition: From 55+ km/h, provoke a lockup and release it within 1 s, then stop without spinning and with the car on the road (asphalt or gravel).

exercises.title: Stopping-distance estimation

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Student Driver (4-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track run-up (MAPS W1): start 120 m behind the start line; the straight is flat from 60 m before the line to 50 m past it, then cambers and banks, so stops belong between the line and about 45 m past it.

features: a tarmac and a gravel stretch

exercises.instructions: Before each run, estimate stopping spot, then brake from exactly 50 km/h; six runs per surface.
exercises.resetInstructions: Go to drill puts you 120 m behind the start line. Reach 50 km/h and brake so you stop on the flat, no more than about 45 m past the line.
exercises.props: Record separate pavement/gravel observations; surface runs need two saved positions.

assessment.successDefinition: Actual bumper stops within 3 m of your predicted stopping marker; no collision.

exercises.title: Trail braking

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track (MAPS W1), start line ~(103, 165). Medium-radius corner with runoff.

exercises.instructions: Begin braking on approach and ease pressure off progressively while steering toward apex.
exercises.resetInstructions: Stationary 75 m before chosen corner; brake marker unchanged.
exercises.props: Choose safe low/medium-speed corner first; use brake input HUD.

assessment.successDefinition: Brake fully released by apex, no sustained lock, all four wheels on roadway and clean exit.

exercises.title: Left-foot braking

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP dirt circle (MAPS W3), ~50 m infield ~(265, 40). Drive the circle around the infield.

exercises.instructions: With right foot steady on light throttle, apply short left-foot brake pressure to adjust rotation.
exercises.resetInstructions: Stationary 50 m before semicircle; approach 30 km/h.
exercises.props: Maintain same initial speed; pedal overlay recommended.

assessment.successDefinition: Track the intended circle without hitting markers, spinning or stopping throttle entirely.

exercises.title: Understeer recognition and correction

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP dirt circle (MAPS W3), ~50 m infield ~(265, 40). 15-20 m radius around the infield.

exercises.instructions: Enter too fast to create safe, mild understeer; reduce speed/steering demand to regain front grip.
exercises.resetInstructions: Stationary 40 m before circle; approach at repeatable 35 km/h.
exercises.props: Start with large runoff; do not deliberately induce at roadside cliff.

assessment.successDefinition: Front regains intended arc before second exit cone; no loss of control or obstacle contact.

exercises.title: Oversteer recognition and correction

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP dirt circle (MAPS W3), ~50 m infield ~(265, 40). Large arc of the circle.

exercises.instructions: In FWD, provoke the rear by lifting off or a short brake on turn-in, then countersteer and settle the car with steady throttle.
exercises.resetInstructions: Stationary 40 m before arc; target 25–35 km/h.
exercises.props: Rear-drive street car; begin at low speed. Disable ESC only if you document the setting.

assessment.successDefinition: No full spin; car aligned with marked exit lane and countersteer unwound before lane end.

exercises.title: Longitudinal weight transfer

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track (MAPS W1), start line ~(103, 165). Broad gravel bend.

exercises.instructions: Do 4 lift-only, 4 light-brake and 4 neutral-entry runs; compare rotation and exit line.
exercises.resetInstructions: Stationary 60 m before gravel turn, same approach speed.
exercises.props: Keep steering entry point identical; compare only input timing.

assessment.successDefinition: Complete entry and exit without cone strike/spin; identify which input increased front bite.

exercises.title: Lift-off oversteer

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track (MAPS W1), start line ~(103, 165). Sweeping gravel corner.

exercises.instructions: Approach under light throttle, lift just before turn-in to rotate, then stabilize smoothly.
exercises.resetInstructions: Stationary 70 m before sweeper; fixed 40 km/h entry.
exercises.props: If the chosen FWD setup barely rotates, use slightly higher safe entry speed, then fix it.

assessment.successDefinition: Observable small rotation without handbrake; no spin or pavement departure.

exercises.title: Brake-induced rotation

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track (MAPS W1), start line ~(103, 165). Open 90-degree gravel corner.

exercises.instructions: Initiate mild turn-in then apply a short controlled brake pulse for rotation.
exercises.resetInstructions: Stationary 60 m before turn; fixed brake cone.
exercises.props: Brake pulse duration adjustable; throttle steady after release.

assessment.successDefinition: Rotate into corner without handbrake or full spin; clean exit between two cones.

exercises.title: Throttle-induced oversteer

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu BX-Series — 200BX Type-LS (M), RWD

environment.areaHint: BMP dirt circle (MAPS W3), ~50 m infield ~(265, 40). Circle (parked: needs RWD/AWD).

exercises.instructions: Use small power pulses to provoke rear slip while turning; then reduce power to regain balance.
exercises.resetInstructions: Stationary 40 m before 20 m radius circle; low gear.
exercises.props: Use wide runoff; avoid measuring drifting angle without sensors.

assessment.successDefinition: Rear breaks traction briefly and is caught; no spin, opposite lock held <3 s.

exercises.parked: Needs RWD or rear-biased AWD (FWD can't oversteer under power).

exercises.title: Handbrake rotation

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track (MAPS W1), start line ~(103, 165). Tightest hairpin or the roundabout (Tie the Knot layout).

exercises.instructions: Brake before entry, briefly apply handbrake to rotate, release, and drive through exit gate.
exercises.resetInstructions: Stationary 70 m before 160–180° gravel bend; face uphill/downhill as chosen.
exercises.props: Select one broad, safe hairpin; preserve same approach speed.

assessment.successDefinition: Make hairpin within road edges; one handbrake application; no stall, spin or barrier touch.

exercises.title: Countersteering and recovery

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu BX-Series — 200BX Type-LS (M), RWD

environment.areaHint: BMP dirt arena (MAPS W2), open dirt ~(337, 96), fenced. Open dirt arc (parked: needs RWD/AWD).

exercises.instructions: Deliberately create mild rear-wheel slide, steer into slide, then unwind to straight exit.
exercises.resetInstructions: Stationary 50 m before arc, identical 30 km/h entry.
exercises.props: Replay steering input if uncertain; count only obvious rear slips.

assessment.successDefinition: No spin, opposite lock unwound by exit marker, final trajectory inside 3 m exit lane.

exercises.parked: Needs RWD or AWD (power-on rear slide to catch).

exercises.title: Maintaining a controlled slip angle

vehicle.displayName: Hirochi Sunburst — NGRC2 Gravel Rally (M), AWD

environment.areaHint: BMP dirt circle (MAPS W3), ~50 m infield ~(265, 40). Circle arc (parked: needs RWD/AWD).

exercises.instructions: Initiate moderate slide before apex; balance throttle/countersteer through a marked 20 m arc.
exercises.resetInstructions: Stationary 70 m before sweeper; fixed 40–50 km/h entry band.
exercises.props: Use side camera replay to judge duration; no need exact angle telemetry.

assessment.successDefinition: Continuous visible controlled rotation through arc, no spin or four-wheel off-course.

exercises.parked: Needs RWD or AWD (FWD can't hold a slide on throttle).

exercises.title: Lateral weight transfer

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP dirt arena (MAPS W2), open dirt ~(337, 96), fenced. Figure-eight around two cones 20 m apart.

exercises.instructions: Steer figure-eight alternating left/right; use lift/brake timing to manage direction change.
exercises.resetInstructions: Stationary 25 m before first cone, centered on approach.
exercises.props: Keep marker spacing identical; test one full figure-eight per attempt.

assessment.successDefinition: Complete both lobes cleanly; no cone contact, spin or abrupt stop.

exercises.title: Scandinavian flicks

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track (MAPS W1), start line ~(103, 165). Wide gravel corner with outside runoff.

exercises.instructions: Briefly steer away from the turn, then reverse the steering with a lift to load the front and swing the rear; catch it and pull straight with throttle, no handbrake.
exercises.resetInstructions: Stationary 100 m before hairpin, same approach lane.
exercises.props: Start around 35–45 km/h; only increase after 8/10 passes.

assessment.successDefinition: Correct-direction rotation followed by clean exit; no handbrake, spin or road-edge contact.

exercises.title: Slaloms and rapid transitions

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP dirt arena (MAPS W2), open dirt ~(337, 96), fenced. Six-cone slalom, 12 m spacing, on the open dirt.

exercises.instructions: Weave alternating around all six cones while maintaining smooth steering and continuous motion.
exercises.resetInstructions: Stationary 30 m before first cone; wheel centered.
exercises.props: Cones spaced approx. 12 m; record exact positions in screenshot.

assessment.successDefinition: No cone contact, no spin; minimum 25 km/h through final gate.

exercises.title: Linked-corner sequencing

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track (MAPS W1), start line ~(103, 165). Two linked bends from one of the layouts.

exercises.instructions: Prioritize second bend exit even if first apex is compromised; compare with single-corner focus.
exercises.resetInstructions: Stationary 80 m before first bend; RSC start gate at vehicle reset.
exercises.props: Use Rally Stage Creator (RSC) 20–40 s custom section; create finish past bend two.

assessment.successDefinition: No contact/off-road, and timed segment within +8% of fastest clean attempt.

exercises.title: Decreasing-radius corners

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: Quarry (MAPS W4), gravel haul roads ~(729, -823). A haul-road bend that tightens toward its exit.

exercises.instructions: Enter conservatively, delay apex, progressively reduce speed as radius tightens.
exercises.resetInstructions: Stationary 80 m before tightening bend, before sightline changes.
exercises.props: Choose and screenshot exact corner once; not a preloaded waypoint.

assessment.successDefinition: No midcorner emergency stop, barrier contact or two-wheel road departure; clear exit gate.

exercises.title: Increasing-radius corners

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: Quarry (MAPS W4), gravel haul roads ~(729, -823). A haul-road bend that opens on exit.

exercises.instructions: Enter at a safe speed, then unwind steering and progressively accelerate as radius opens.
exercises.resetInstructions: Stationary 60 m before opening bend; mark start and exit.
exercises.props: Use speedometer/replay if observing acceleration pickup.

assessment.successDefinition: Exit in lane; throttle increases after apex without wheelspin, spin or boundary contact.

exercises.title: Blind corners

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: Quarry (MAPS W4), gravel haul roads ~(729, -823). A bend hidden by a spoil heap or crest.

features: blind: hidden by a crest, heap or trees

exercises.instructions: Drive the turn from the cockpit at a conservative fixed approach speed, using visible cues.

exercises.props: Treat map familiarity as a limitation; eventually transfer to unseen routes.

assessment.successDefinition: No roadside contact or wheels beyond road boundary; correct direction chosen before sightline opens.

exercises.title: Uphill and downhill corners

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: Quarry (MAPS W4), gravel haul roads ~(729, -823). Spiral Descent: uphill and downhill bends.

exercises.instructions: Alternate five uphill and five downhill turns at comparable entry speeds.

exercises.props: Five attempts per direction; keep two saved checkpoints/screenshots.

assessment.successDefinition: Clean exit and no late brake lock on downhill; correct gear and control uphill.

exercises.title: Road camber

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track (MAPS W1), start line ~(103, 165). Banked berm corners.

exercises.instructions: Drive inside- and outside-camber arcs; note how line and speed change available grip.
exercises.resetInstructions: Stationary 50 m before first cambered segment; direction fixed.
exercises.props: Pick two actual cambered segments on the west training area.

assessment.successDefinition: Stay inside lane and avoid severe understeer/oversteer; identify which side reduced grip.

exercises.title: Mixed-surface transitions

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track (MAPS W1), start line ~(103, 165). Tarmac start line onto gravel.

exercises.instructions: Cross tarmac→gravel while turning gently; adapt braking point and steering to lower grip.
exercises.resetInstructions: Stationary 80 m before identified pavement/gravel boundary.
exercises.props: If geometry differs, select a different confirmed paved-to-gravel interface.

exercises.title: Snow vs gravel vs tarmac

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track (MAPS W1), start line ~(103, 165). Gravel circuit vs. the tarmac start area (snow: Automation Test Track, optional).

features: one corner on each surface: tarmac, gravel, snow

exercises.instructions: Perform 4 controlled corners on snow, 4 on tarmac, 4 on gravel; record safe approach speed and braking behavior.

exercises.title: FWD driving technique

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track (MAPS W1), start line ~(103, 165). Moderate gravel corner with runoff.

exercises.instructions: Use a small lift/brake to rotate before apex; reapply throttle to stabilize FWD exit.
exercises.resetInstructions: Stationary 70 m before turn, lower entry speed due to road tires.
exercises.props: Keep all car parts/tires stock so lesson is about drivetrain.

assessment.successDefinition: No power-on plowing past outer boundary and no handbrake; exit aligned.

exercises.title: RWD driving technique

vehicle.displayName: Hirochi SBR4 — NGRC2 Rally Gravel (M), RWD

exercises.instructions: Use steering and moderate power to create rear slip, then meter throttle to stabilize exit.
exercises.resetInstructions: Stationary 70 m before turn; 35–45 km/h entry.
exercises.props: NGRC2 RWD gravel configuration is an official vehicle preset.

assessment.successDefinition: No full spin, off-road excursion or sustained wheelspin that stalls progress.

exercises.title: AWD driving technique

vehicle.displayName: Hirochi Sunburst — NGRC2 Gravel Rally (M), AWD

exercises.title: Crest management

exercises.props: Choose an actual safe crest and mark 20 m recovery zone.

exercises.title: Jump takeoff and landing

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

exercises.title: Rough terrain and suspension unloading

exercises.title: Puncture and damage adaptation

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

exercises.title: Vehicle setup comparisons
